summary: Firefox’s CSS platform now supports more modern standards and features, including flex-wrap: balance, flex-line-count parsing, overscroll-behavior: chain, CSS Typed OM transforms, and updated appearance and view-transition behavior. The work also improves font metrics through Skrifa, color and stylesheet memory use, CSS error reporting, selector matching, language attributes, and parsing performance, while removing obsolete features such as :-moz-placeholder and the dom.viewTransitions.enabled preference.
